paper_title: Thermal Simulation of a CPU Based on Model Order Reduction

evidence.value: Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) with Galerkin projection method
CPU chip with 3D structure, device layer with functional units A, B, and C
Three uniform power pulses applied at functional units A, B, and C with period of 3.333μs representing average over 10k cycles at 3 GHz
Adiabatic boundary conditions applied to chip surfaces except bottom substrate where Robin boundary condition used with ambient temperature of 0°C
POD model with 3 modes provides good accuracy compared to FEniCS simulation; with 5 modes achieves excellent agreement with FEniCS; reduction in degrees of freedom by more than 4 orders of magnitude

missing_for_exact_replication: Exact power density values at each functional unit
Detailed dimensions of the CPU chip
Ambient temperature during actual testing conditions (only simulation ambient given as 0°C)
Convection coefficients or heat transfer parameters at boundaries
